plugin.name: Ledger Catgirl
plugin.description: A meow bookkeeper that changes tone with how outrageous the spending is: cute for everyday expenses, snarky for absurd prices, and hissing at cat or AI expenses. It reads the current catgirl's persona, so a gentle "never gets angry" persona downgrades hissing to a mild grumble
entry.add_expense.name: Record an expense
entry.preview_expense.name: Preview tone
entry.preview_expense.description: Preview the tone and line a given expense would produce, without writing to the ledger
entry.expense_summary.name: Expense summary
entry.recent_expenses.name: Recent entries
entry.recent_expenses.description: List the most recent ledger entries
entry.ledger_status.name: Ledger status
entry.ledger_status.description: Show the ledger location, entry count and current tone settings
entry.check_persona.name: Check hissing permission
entry.check_persona.description: Read the current persona and report whether hissing is allowed, with the reason
